structural_variants.otherCytogenetics: Eighteen of twenty-one cells examined were trisomy 8, previously observed.Two of these cells also had an extra 1q attached to a chromosome 21 short arm, and two other cells had an extra 1q attached to a chromosome 22 short arm.
